Sure it could have. He could have dropped out with no strong candidates to replace him. Instead, the lineup to take his place is surprisingly solid for a change. Let's keep a little optimism here.

Platner dropped out with plenty of time for someone else to step up. Now the real battle for the midterms here can begin. I have faith in my state, and the majority of its people. Sure, we make our share of mistakes, but we're stubborn, and from everything I've heard and read, I think it's safe to say we know exactly what we want right now.

Anyone else notice how hard the attacks have been pouring in all of a sudden since this happened - with a bunch of comments condemning, mocking, and trying to divide/shame us on the matter? Things were pretty quite on MAGA's end for months up until all of this, even with everything else happening. You know what that says to me? It says they either planned this from the start, or they're trying to capitalize on it as fast/hard as possible - to cast doubt, and weaken the resolve that got this movement resoundingly through the primaries. In either case, they've overplayed their hand, because now we know just how scared they really are - if this is the level of effort they're going to! If we stay as united and focused as we were during the primaries, we have a real shot at finally unseating Collins!

So, would you all buck up a little for pity's sake? You're leaving a friggin' Independent of all things to do the heavy lifting in terms of party morale here! C'mon, Dems! Get it together!
